relevance_note: The paper describes seven individuals from three families carrying NOD2 variants: 'The probands from families 1 and 2 carried pathogenic variants in NOD2 (NM_022162.3)'.
method_note: Read the full paper; JSON assembled by a short Python script whose values were all typed from my reading; every span checked verbatim against the paper by script. Table 1 has patients as rows; 'N' cells were used as 'excluded' only with the legend definition 'N = none' quoted as a second span; 'NA' treated as not reported. The 'Other Clinical Finding' and 'Relevant Laboratory Findings' columns with 'N' were not used to exclude specific checklist items (whole-category negatives). Labels: 'II:1' is used in families 1 and 3, so these are 'II:1 (Family 1)' and 'II:1 (Family 3)'. In-scope relatives with no own description: the parents of both probands (tested negative; 'As parents of both probands did not carry the change') and the unaffected maternal grandmother in family 3 (NLRC4 carrier). Previously published people with individual facts in the Introduction were included: refs [19], [20], [21] (Jabs proband and brother); [21] is described only as 'clinical symptoms consistent with BS'. Contradictions: (1) the Abstract gives the family-3 NOD2 variant as c.1412G>T p.(Arg471Leu) while Results and Discussion (5 mentions) give c.1412G>C p.(Arg471Pro); the Results version was recorded. (2) II:1 (Family 1): meningoencephalitis at 5 and 11 years in text vs 'at age 5 y and 12 y' in Table 1; parotid/lacrimal involvement at 11 years in text vs 'at 12' in table; Table 1 gives 'active panuveitis/3 y' while text describes anterior uveitis to 7 years and panuveitis developing by 12 years. (3) II:2: Table 1 'active panuveitis/11 y' vs text anterior chamber activity from 11 and panuveitis found at 24. (4) II:1 (Family 3): 'examined at 43 years' in text vs 'F/44 y' (age at last ophthalmic examination) in Table 1; 44 y recorded as last evaluation. (5) III:2 is called 'monozygotic triplet sister' and 'monozygotic twin sister'. (6) III:1: Table 1 'probable polyarthritis/preschool' vs text 'active arthritis has not been detected' (since 13 years); both rows emitted, checklist arthritis left not reported. De novo for families 1 and 2 recorded from 'parents of both probands did not carry the change', although the authors say 'likely' and that paternity/maternity testing was not performed. Family-3 NOD2 inheritance for the triplets recorded as maternal because the mother is among the 'five family members' carrying it; not recorded for II:1 (Family 3) or I:1 (I:1's relation to II:1 is not stated in text). NLRC4 c.928C>T attributed to III:1 and III:2 (panel-tested) and to II:1 (Family 3) only through 'uveitis was only present in members who also harbored c.928C>T in NLRC4' (zygosity not recorded for her); ABCC6 variants recorded as compound heterozygous from 'confirmed their trans configuration'. Disease label left not reported for family-3 members except II:1 (Family 3) ('a dual diagnosis of PXE and BS'): the paper says BS was diagnosed 'in four cases from three families' without naming them. Normal BCVA (1.0) recorded as excluded 'reduced visual acuity' but not used to exclude the broader checklist item 'visual impairment or blindness'. F2 checklist arthritis observed from the named-group statement 'Both individuals with known NOD2 pathogenic variants developed a classical BS triad'; her own description is tenosynovitis without erosive arthritis.
